stemMd: A phone plan costs $18 per month plus $0.04 for each text beyond 100 texts. What is the monthly cost for 175 texts?
explanationMd: Only 175−100=75 texts are charged separately. Their cost is 75 times 0.04=3 dollars, which adds to the base 18 dollars for a total of 21.

distractorRationale.a: This does not charge for all seventy-five extra texts.
distractorRationale.d: This uses an incorrect number or price of extra texts.
distractorRationale.c: This charges for all texts, ignoring the included hundred.
